Chat.Desc: The window that lets you chat with buddies within a world.
Chat.Title: Messenger Window

Equip.Desc: The window that shows the equipped items, and allowing the character to equip/unequip them.\nOpen the item inventory alongside it to use the equip. items.
Equip.Title: Equipment Window (E)

Item.Desc: The window that allows the character to see the items it owns.\nThe items are categorized under Equip., Use, Set-Up, and Etc. items.
Item.Title: Item Inventory (I)

Delete.Desc: Delete the chosen map from the list.
Delete.Title: Delete Map

Move.Desc: Teleports to the map of your choice, or to the map where the chosen character is.
Move.Title: Move

Register.Desc: Registers the map the character is at to the teleport list. Can save up to 5 maps.
Register.Title: Register Map

RegisterEx.Desc: Registers the map where the character is located into the Teleport List. Can register upto 10 different places.
RegisterEx.Title: Register Map

Menu.Desc: The window that lets you change the options or game infos.\nCan change game and system option.\nCan also see quest info, party info, and the community info.
Menu.Title: Menu

QuestAlarm.Desc: Click on Quest Alarm button if you wish to register the current quest into the Quest Alarm. Up to 5 quests can be registered in this alarm.

Shop.Desc: It's a place where, armed with Cash, you'll be able to purchase accessories, clothes, messenger item, hair salon coupons, coupons for plastic surgery, and other various items.
Shop.Title: Cash Shop

Skill.Desc: The window that shows the detailed look of the skillbook owned by the character.\nUse skill points to learn the skills available.
Skill.Title: Skill Window (K)

Stat.Desc: The window that shows detailed character info and its abilities.\nUse AP to enhance many different kinds of abilities.
Stat.Title: Ability Window (S)

StatAuto.Desc: Distributes the remaining AP according to your level and class.
StatAuto.Title: Stat Auto-Assign

StatAuto1.Desc: Distributes the remaining AP according to Brawler requirements.
StatAuto1.Title: Stat Auto-Assign (Brawler)

StatAuto2.Desc: Distributes the remaining AP according to Gunslinger requirements.
StatAuto2.Title: Stat Auto-Assign (Gunslinger)

Whisper.Desc: Press the button to choose the character you want to whisper to.\nPress it once more to disable whisper.
Whisper.Title: Whisper

0.Desc: Once the name is made,\nthe name can't be changed.

1.Desc:
Can make the job advancement to Warrior, Bowman, Thief, Magician, or Pirate. 
Warrior : Minimum of Level 10, Perion
Bowman : Minimum of Level 10, Henesys
Magician : Minimum of Level 8, Ellinia
Thief : Minimum of Level 10, Kerning City
Pirate : Minimum of Level 10, The Nautilus

10.Desc: The higher this stat, the higher the accuracy and strenghth of your magic attack. The most important stat that determines the magic attacks for mages.
10.Title: Intelligence (INT)

11.Desc: The higher it is, the higher the avoidability is. \nIt determines the Thief's attacking ability and the Mage's magic attack accuracy. \nAlso, the higher it is, the less EXP a character loses by dying.
11.Title: Luck (LUK)

12.Desc: Amount to increase STR, DEX, INT,LUK, HP and MP. For STR, DEX, INT and LUK, every 1 AP used will increase the stats by 1.  For HP and MP, it differs pending on the jobs and characters.  5 Points will be given upon level up.
12.Title: AP(Ability Point)

2.Desc: Accumulate enough EXP to raise the level of the character.
2.Title: Level

3.Desc: The main community of the communities the account belongs to. Press "G" to check guild info.
3.Title: Main Guild

4.Desc: It's a health stat, and if it reaches 0, the character dies.\nHP decreases if either attacked by an enemy or if a certain skill is used.\nIt can go up to the maximum of 30,000 points.
4.Title: Health Point

5.Desc: The stat needed to use various skills.\nIt can go up to the maximum of 30,000 points.
5.Title: Mana Point

6.Desc: The amount of experience gained. \nObtained by killing a monster or completing a quest.
6.Title: EXP

7.Desc: The level of fame can be increased or decreased, based on other users. Some equipments and quests require the character reach a certain level of fame.
7.Title: Fame

8.Desc: The stat needed to use heavy weapons and/or armors.\nIt determines the attacking ability of the warriors and pirates (Brawlers).
8.Title: Strength (STR)

9.Desc: This stat is vital to making direct attacks using a weapon. This is the most significant stat when it comes to the strength of the attacks for warriors and pirates (Gunslingers).
9.Title: Dexterity (DEX)

0.Desc: The stat that impacts the damage caused by physical attacks. This stat is related to strength (STR) for warriors and magicians, dexterity (DEX) for bowmen, strength, dexterity and luck (LUK) for thieves and strength and dexterity for pirates. The above stat and the equipment's physical attack are added to decide on the overall physical attack.
0.Title: Attack

1.Desc: The stat that determines the ability to defend the weapon attack.\nBased on all equipped armors' weapon def.
1.Title: Weapon Def.

2.Desc: The stat that determines the success rate and the attacking ability of spells.\nBased on INT and equipped items' magic power.
2.Title: Magic

3.Desc: The stat for defending spells.\nBased on magic def. of every armor that's been equipped.
3.Title: Magic Def.

4.Desc: The stat that determines the accuracy of weapon attack. \nThe higher, the more accurate.\nBased on dexterity and the equipment item options.
4.Title: Accuracy

5.Desc: The stat that enables the character to avoid weapon damage.\nThe higher it is, the better the character avoids weapon damage.\nBased on dexterity, luck, and the equipment item options.
5.Title: Avoidability

7.Desc: A character's speed can increase upto 140%. Can be changed through equipment item options or skills.
7.Title: Speed

8.Desc: A character's jump ability can increase upto 123%. \nCan be changed through equipment item options or skills.
8.Title: Jump
